_note: Amendment 2 of the Real-IAD Variety holdout, 2026-11-10, written after the first manifest run stopped and before any map, metric or manifest file of the holdout exists. It amends configs/holdout_plan.json (sha256 7964a231...) under configs/holdout_lock.json (lock_sha256 7cbd37f9c884..., public commit ea090cae of github.com/kimdh10/d20-holdout-prereg) and is frozen in configs/holdout_lock_a2.json.
what_happened: run_holdout_manifest.sh (2026-11-10 16:1x KST) stopped with ValueError in build_manifests.add_mask: the mask of retaining_ring/NG/GelatinousContaminant/S0005/..._C1_....png is 3048 x 2961 pixels while its image is 2629 x 2629. Before it stopped the builder had hashed the files and computed mask statistics of the categories before retaining_ring in memory; nothing was written (the manifest is written at the end), displayed or printed except the per-category done lines and this error.
rule_added: A defective test image whose mask has a different size from its image (from the file headers), or whose mask file cannot be read, has no usable pixel ground truth and is excluded, like a defective image listed without a mask (configs/holdout_select_amend1.json, S3). The mask is never resized or cropped to fit, because the correspondence cannot be checked without looking at the images. Excluded images and their counts per category and stratum are written to the manifest summary and reported in the paper.
no_category_recheck: Categories are not re-selected: every selected category stays in, with the images that remain; a category left without absence or without presence images contributes nothing to the matched gap (as the analysis code already handles) and is reported.
unchanged: everything else in configs/holdout_plan.json (data, localizers, metric, primary and secondary rules, margin, sensitivity analyses, failure handling, predictions, interpretation)
code: build_manifest_variety.py (the size check and the exclusion record), freeze_holdout.py (lock path argument; the new lock lists this amendment), holdout_report.py and the job scripts (lock path holdout_lock_a2.json); all other files unchanged with the hashes of the first lock
